items.title: George "Tex" Stephens Interview, 1995-07-21
items.q: I got along pretty good with B.H. because the house on Fifth Street was right across the street from the jailhouse.

ctx.x: So, as I can answer the question, were you very motivated in school?

In a sense, I was a good average student. I was always a good talking type of person. I could always rap pretty good, as you would say. My subjects were history. I wasn't a very good mathematician, not even today, but I liked math, but I never would take the time to concentrate on it. But I can do it pretty good now, after growing up working in business with it. But I was mostly into history, and geography, and technical things like that. And then, see, I learned how to swim in the Mississippi River. I remember,…
